method: Independent assistant directly inspected actual exported PNGs and magnified the approved enemy-label region. File checks do not substitute for these visual observations.

findings.criterion: Clean board in main and native viewport
findings.evidence: Only BEGIN and END have board text. SPARK/SPLIT/JOIN names, numerical damage/branch/End values, cost crystals and TEMP are absent. Rune symbols and connecting strokes remain.
Split has a left stem and upper-right/lower-right branches; Join is an upright trident. Board and toolbar visibly share these silhouettes, with editable glyph sources and identical vector path data.

Main retains the reference BOSS label, intent/name/health, player HUD, wiring labels/counts, detailed hand, Draw/Discard piles/counts, action log, external forecast, Cast cost and navigation. Only Remove/Rotate are editing actions.

findings.criterion: State and rotation specimens reflect current board
findings.evidence: All board cells in state sheets are clean; explanatory labels/values are outside the cells. Four rotations,24/32/48glyphs and137/72cell samples remain. Power collars, focus dashes, selection check, invalid cross and unavailable cue remain distinct.

Native360x640 uses72px cells and a visible scrolling boundary. Lower companion includes real piles around a scrolling detailed card, controls, forecast and Cast. Font sheet clearly distinguishes endpoint text from external values. No missing-glyph boxes or obvious text clipping were found.

findings.result: pass for reconstruction; pixel identity not claimed
findings.evidence: Existing separated painted assets are retained unchanged; new composition and vector geometry implement the latest visual changes. The actor painting, Noto letterforms and frame/icon execution are not pixel-identical to the flattened reference.
No runtime evaluator/control behavior or device verification is established by these previews. Approval of the supplied reference is not retroactive approval of different production artwork.
